title: Add config file linting to the CLI
summary: Linting rules and unit tests are implemented and passing locally. One required cross-platform check for Windows path handling has not been run yet.
decision_reason: Implementation is on track, but the required Windows path handling check is still pending, so the change is not ready to approve.
next_action: Run the pending Windows path handling test and attach the results as evidence.

detail.overview: The new lint subcommand validates config files against the documented format and reports line-level errors. Rule definitions, error formatting, and unit tests are complete. The remaining work is a cross-platform check: path normalization on Windows has not been exercised, and one helper uses os.path.join in a way that needs verification there.
evidence: lint subcommand verified against 6 sample config files
Windows path handling check: not yet run
changes: src/cli/lint.py: new lint subcommand with rule engine
tests/test_lint.py: unit tests for all current rules
open_questions: Does path normalization behave the same on Windows runners?
